notes.title: Developer Update
notes.notes:
We are busy working on the next update.

So far we have successfully tested Achievements and Leaderboards. Publishing and subscribing Workshop Items is the next test. This will allow you to share your creations and enjoy the creativity of others. 

As always, we love to hear what you have to say: join us in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2931520/discussions/]discussions[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/channels/1159624932939026542/1246516838939234344]discord[/url]

notes.notes: Let's insure mechanic energy is conserved during integration.

notes.title: New marble dynamics in funnels
notes.notes:
[list]
Marbles in funnels now use Lagrangian mechanics instead of Epic's Unreal physics.
Vive menu items are moved to proper place.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes:
Loop Boost setting is honored; trying to get achievements/Leaderboard working; fix for background music randomly stopping. We are working hard to insure funnels and blocks work properly (that is, replace Unreal physics with something more robust for these pieces).

Please join the discussion to influence our priorities.

notes.title: Marble Mechanics Is Coming Tomorrow
notes.notes:
Greetings, Marble Run Maestros!

The moment we’ve all been waiting for is almost here! After two years of tireless effort, we’re thrilled to announce that Marble Mechanics will be ready to roll out tomorrow! Your support has been our driving force, and we’re incredibly grateful for each and every one of you who have wish-listed our game.

We’ve poured our hearts into this project, and we sincerely hope it brings as much joy to you as it has to us in creating it. As a small indie team, your engagement and goodwill are our most valuable assets. We’re eager to hear your thoughts, so please don’t hesitate to share your feedback and reviews. Tell your friends about our game and let’s grow this community together.

Tomorrow, we’re hosting a live stream where you can join us for a chat. Let’s put our heads together and see what incredible marble runs we can create. We can’t wait to see you there! 🎮🚀
